code: for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA('ScreenGui') then g.Enabled=false end end local RS=game:GetService('RunService') pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep('MareShot') end) RS:BindToRenderStep('MareShot',Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,function() local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera local cf=workspace:GetAttribute('ShotCF') if cf then cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable cam.CFrame=cf cam.FieldOfView=workspace:GetAttribute('ShotFov') or 65 end end) return 'bound'

local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local ok,err=pcall(function() local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene) PS.build({portId='london',portName='london',level=4,shipId='galleon',hasShipyard=true,facilities={'bank','guild','harbormaster'},storyCount=0,companions={}},function() end) end) local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character if c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then c.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-6,6,10)) end workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',60) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-100,330,1),Vector3.new(-100,0,0),Vector3.new(0,1,0))) return tostring(ok)..tostring(err)

local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('PortScene') if not f then return 'ANIMAL london NOSCENE' end local by={} local first=nil for _,m in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do if m:IsA('Model') and m:GetAttribute('AnimalSpecies') then  local sp=m:GetAttribute('AnimalSpecies') local r=by[sp] or {n=0,rig={},j=0,p=0,legs={},face={}} by[sp]=r r.n+=1  local rig=tostring(m:GetAttribute('AnimalMotionRig')) r.rig[rig]=(r.rig[rig] or 0)+1  r.j=math.max(r.j,m:GetAttribute('AnimalRigJoints') or 0) r.p=math.max(r.p,m:GetAttribute('AnimalRigParts') or 0)  local lg=tostring(m:GetAttribute('AnimalLegGroups'))..'/'..tostring(m:GetAttribute('AnimalRequiredLegGroups')) r.legs[lg]=(r.legs[lg] or 0)+1  local fc=tostring(m:GetAttribute('AnimalFacing')) r.face[fc]=(r.face[fc] or 0)+1  local bones=0 for _,b in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if b:IsA('Bone') then bones+=1 end end r.bones=math.max(r.bones or 0,bones)  if not first and (sp=='cow' or sp=='horse' or sp=='sheep' or sp=='pig') then first=m end end end local moved='none' if first then local js={} for _,b in ipairs(first:GetDescendants()) do if b:IsA('Bone') then js[b]=b.Transform end end local p0=first:GetPivot().Position task.wait(0.6) local d=0 for b,t in pairs(js) do d+=(b.Transform.Position-t.Position).Magnitude+(b.Transform.LookVector-t.LookVector).Magnitude end moved=first:GetAttribute('AnimalSpecies')..' 뼈변화='..string.format('%.3f',d)..' 이동='..string.format('%.2f',(first:GetPivot().Position-p0).Magnitude)  local p=first:GetPivot() workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',40) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotCF',CFrame.lookAt(p.Position+p.RightVector*9+Vector3.new(0,3.5,0),p.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0))) end local out={} for sp,r in pairs(by) do local function j(t) local s={} for k,v in pairs(t) do table.insert(s,k..':'..v) end return table.concat(s,',') end  table.insert(out,sp..'x'..r.n..'['..j(r.rig)..' 관절'..r.j..' 조각'..r.p..' 뼈'..(r.bones or 0)..' 다리'..j(r.legs)..' '..j(r.face)..']') end return 'ANIMAL london '..moved..' | '..table.concat(out,' ')
